podcast.body: This was the first-ever single released by the group, featuring David Jones (later David Bowie) on vocals. It came out in June 1964. "That's David Jones and The King Bees. Liza Jane released June 1964."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was the only single released by Davy Jones with The King Bees, marking the first recording to feature David Robert Jones. Despite promotion by Decca Records, the single sold poorly, leading Jones to leave the band after a few weeks. "This is Liza Jane, the only single released under the moniker, Davy Jones with the King Bees."
